Contract Generator.contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::openCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = cashDeskID),
		currentStore: Store = CurrentStore
	precondition:
		currentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		currentStore.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		currentStore.IsOpened = true and
		currentCashDesk.IsOpened = false
	postcondition:
		result = currentCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(currentCashDesk)
}
